name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A shadcn/ui sheet (side panel) built on scrollsheet instead of Radix Dialog. Same Sheet/SheetTrigger/SheetContent/SheetHeader/SheetFooter/SheetTitle/SheetDescription/SheetClose API, backed by a native <dialog> in the top layer with drag-to-dismiss on every edge. `side` lives on <Sheet> (the root) rather than SheetContent. Zero runtime dependencies beyond scrollsheet itself.
author: Ansuman Shah <https://github.com/ansumanshah>
